intent: Let a user switch between a small set of peer views or filtered subsets of content within the same page context.
avoid_when: there are more than a handful of destinations, or they represent full navigation rather than local view-switching (use app-navigation)
only one view exists (there is nothing to switch between)
a11y_contract: built on React Aria Tabs/TabList/TabPanel: arrow-key navigation between tabs and aria-selected/aria-controls wiring to the associated panel come for free
responsive_contract: the underline/track indicator is only rendered from the md breakpoint up
requires_data: an ordered list of tabs with label and associated panel content
